resources.string: Detects when you open an app you chose to guard, so Watch Instead can show one of your saved videos. Watch Instead only sees which guarded app opened and, if you set no cooldown or a focus schedule, when you return to your home screen. It never reads your screen, messages or passwords.
Turn on the Watch Instead app guard so your videos can appear.

Watch Instead has no accounts, ads or analytics, and we run no servers.

Your saved links, notes and settings stay on this device and are not included in cloud backups. Uninstalling Watch Instead deletes them. If you export a backup, you choose where the file goes, and it is not encrypted, so keep it somewhere you trust.

The accessibility service detects when an app on your guarded list comes to the foreground, so Watch Instead can show a saved video. If you set the cooldown to None or add a focus schedule, it also detects when you return to your home screen, so it knows when to prompt again. It does not read screen content, typed text, messages or passwords. Watch Instead keeps a history of its prompts on your device (which guarded app, when, what you chose and any reason you tapped) to show your stats. This history is used only on your device and is never collected or shared. You can clear it in Settings, and it is included in backups you export.

When you save a link, Watch Instead requests its title and thumbnail. For YouTube and TikTok links the request goes to that service's public embed endpoint, and for other links it goes to the linked website. Thumbnails are then loaded from the address that service provides. These services receive the link and your IP address, as with any web request.

Opening a saved video hands it to the matching app or your browser, whose own privacy terms apply.
Android needs you to turn on Watch Instead\'s accessibility service.
What it accesses: only which app is opening, and only for the apps you chose. If you set no cooldown or a focus schedule, it also notices when you return to your home screen.
Why: so Watch Instead can show a saved video the moment you open one.

If Android says the setting is restricted: open Settings, then Apps, then Watch Instead, tap the ⋮ menu, choose Allow restricted settings, and try again. You only need to do this once.

Some payment and banking apps refuse to open while this service is on. If that happens, use the Usage access version of Watch Instead instead.

If protection keeps switching off, set Watch Instead's battery usage to Unrestricted in its app settings. Some phone brands stop background services aggressively.
